rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for acting falsely sincere or caring.

example.english: They hypocritically asked how I was, then ignored me.
example.traditional: 佢假惺惺咁問候我，轉個頭就唔理我喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaa2 sing1 sing1 gam3 man6 hau6 ngo5 zyun2 go3 tau4 zau6 m4 lei5 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone says or shows one thing while inwardly thinking the opposite.

example.english: They hypocritically said they supported me, but inwardly wanted me to fail.
example.traditional: 佢口是心非咁話支持我，其實心入面最想我失敗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hau2 si6 sam1 fei1 gam3 waa6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 kei4 sat6 sam1 jap6 min6 zeoi3 soeng2 ngo5 sat1 baai6

rows.note: Use this when the hypocrisy involves putting on a show of moral kindness or righteousness.

example.english: They hypocritically donated money and even asked people to take photos for the newspaper.
example.traditional: 佢假仁假義咁捐錢，仲要叫人影相登報。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6 gam3 gyun1 cin2 zung6 jiu3 giu3 jan4 jing2 soeng2 dang1 bou3
